A tragic Bronx shelter case ends in a psychiatric ruling rather than prison, highlighting the complex intersection of severe mental illness and criminal justice.

Bronx Mother Found Not Responsible
Evidence: legal justice, medical consensus, psychiatric care
#Aletheia #Justice

Breitbart reports on a Bronx judge finding Dimone Fleming not criminally responsible for the 2022 deaths of her children due to postpartum psychosis, framing it alongside social media skepticism.

Dimone Fleming was found not guilty by reason of insanity for the 2022 deaths of her two young sons. She was suffering from severe postpartum psychosis, experiencing hallucinations that the world was ending.
